dct_description_sm: Abstract: This point layer contains the locations of the 33 polling locations within the City of Cambridge. Each precinct has one polling location where voters cast their ballots during local, state, and federal elections.
Purpose: This layer was created for the Cambridge Election Commission, for mapping, and for public distribution.
